schema.state: {0x00 string name, 0x08 sid name, 0x18 anim-node tree root (anim-node-animation | -blend | -parametric | -gesture | -subsystem-ik | -instance-0), 0x20 sid primary anim, 0x28 sid state tag/family, 0x48 anim-transition-group, 0x60 script-lambda (phase/speed update; calls player-anim-speed-mult), 0x70 hash-table of per-subsystem info {player: anim-state-player-info, door: door-state-info, subsystem: subsystem-state-info(symbol-array of native *Action classes), dynamic: dynamic-state-info-array([sid flag, float phase, int mode, boxed value])}}
schema.transition: {0x00 sid event ('auto' or named event e.g. ladder-up), 0x08 int flags, 0x10 array of conditions (anim-transition-condition {int type, float phase} | anim-transition-condition-lambda {script-lambda}), 0x20 sid target state, 0x38 float blend seconds, 0x3C float, 0x4C int curve?}
